trial_court: Court of MS. SHEETAL CHAUDHARY PRADHAN, ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE-02, SOUTH-EAST DISTRICT, SAKET COURTS, NEW DELHI (SC No. : 41/2018)
case_name: State vs Rakesh Kumar Pandey & Ors.

parties.respondent_defendant: Rakesh Kumar Pandey, Angad Raj Sharma, Dev Raj Sharma

facts_of_case: Complainant Dr. Sita Ram Paswan filed FIR against accused Rakesh Kumar Pandey, Angad Raj Sharma and Dev Raj Sharma for offences under Sections 452, 323, 506, 34 IPC and Section 3(1)(r)(s) SC/ST Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the complaint was false.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the complainant's version of the incident is to be accepted unless it is found to be improbable or impossible.

legal_principles.principle: The law is clear that the police have a duty to protect the complainant from harm.
legal_principles.held: It is the duty of the police to ensure that the complainant is protected from further harm and not to harass or intimidate them.

outcome.result: All three accused persons stand acquitted.
outcome.final_order: The trial court held that the prosecution failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt, hence all three accused were acquitted.

use_for_drafting: drafting a plea for acquittal in cheque bounce cases
preparing a defence strategy for SC/ST act cases
advising clients on the implications of IPC sections 452, 323, 506 and 34
